description: Keyword groups used by scripts/forensics_digest.py to build focused digests from data/history.json
notes: strong_terms and title_keywords produce confirmed matches.

weak_terms are short acronyms that SAM substring matching also hits inside unrelated titles (e.g. DC3 in a part number, MSAB inside a place name). A notice matched only by a weak term lands in the review section instead of the confirmed list.
title_keywords are matched case-insensitively against the notice title, so a notice collected under a broad term like Cyber still shows up when its title mentions forensics.

watch_orgs are contracting offices that buy forensics tooling under titles carrying no forensics keyword (vendor names like Searchlight Cyber, Chainalysis, BitMindz). A notice from one of these offices with no keyword hit lands in the review section, never the confirmed list. Only add an office after checking its record in data/archive/notices-master.json: ICE IOSD Dallas qualified with 14 of 14 archived notices being investigative or forensics tooling.
